goal: Provide external applications with an ordered, pull-based stream of block and mempool events over IPC
Resolve long-standing gaps in ZMQ where intermediate blocks drop and transaction removal reasons are missing
Prevent unbounded memory consumption by enforcing byte limits on notification buffers
agreement: No substantive comments or reviews yet

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it adds a major new notification interface that directly solves long-standing client pain points
External clients gain reliable block tracking without skipped blocks and clear mempool removal tracking
Bounded memory buffers protect the node from memory exhaustion during rapid block updates
